title: No way to set truncation to auto for Gpt-5 models
body:
### Description

I see in https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/907007422dfd124c7fa7f7f100cad5ee96d5df39/packages/openai/src/responses/openai-responses-language-model.ts#L1302 `requiredAutoTruncation` is set to false and is never set to true anywhere else, which means this line here https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/907007422dfd124c7fa7f7f100cad5ee96d5df39/packages/openai/src/responses/openai-responses-language-model.ts#L231 never evaluates to true and hence can never set `truncation` to `true`. 

I've also tried setting `truncation` to `true` in `providerOptions` and that seems to be getting dropped. Is there a reason why these extra parameters in `providerOptions` are getting dropped like that? I'd think that if users are providing extra parameters in providerOptions they should just be passed through to the underlying provider as is, no?

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/openai): support truncation parameter
linked_prs.body:
## Background

The OpenAI Responses API supports a `truncation` parameter to control how prompts exceeding the context window are handled, but there was no way to configure this through `providerOptions` ([Issue #9393](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/9393)).

## Summary

Added support for the `truncation` parameter in OpenAI Responses API provider options.

**Changes:**
- Added `truncation: z.enum(['auto', 'disabled']).nullish()` to `openaiResponsesProviderOptionsSchema`
- Removed unused `requiredAutoTruncation` field (was always `false` since initial implementation, never used)
- Moved `truncation` to provider options section (it's not model-specific, works with all Responses API models)
- Added 3 tests: `'auto'`, `'disabled'`, and undefined cases
